nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User-facing documentation (in Russian) for the Instagram customer-support CRM channel integration, covering its purpose, handled webhooks, automated actions, configuration settings, and setup procedure.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Technical notes for the Instagram CRM channel detailing storage responsibilities (MariaDB business-map table vs Redis streams), Graph API token handling, SQL migrations, the single-stream worker model, and the dialog rating flow.

nodes.name: ui_template.css
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the server-rendered Instagram OAuth/connection status page, defining the responsive panel layout, status badges, action buttons, and light/dark tone theming.

nodes.name: ui_template.html
nodes.summary: HTML template with Python format placeholders for the server-rendered Instagram connection status page, rendering account info, status badge, localized language switcher, notices, and action steps.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python str.format-style placeholders (e.g. {safe_heading}, {style_block}) interpolated at render time.
